heroTitle: Stay at the heart of Mechelen
heroText: A characterful historic hotel in the city centre, steps from the Grote Markt and St Rumbold's Cathedral.
aboutBody: The 33 rooms of the charming Hotel 3 Paardekens were thoroughly renovated and refurbished in 2010 - a historical renovation that preserved the property's personality while adding the comfort expected of a 3-star city hotel. The pride of the hotel is the glass-enclosed breakfast room on the top floor, with an impressive view of St Rumbold's Cathedral.
breakfastText: Begin the day in our glass-enclosed top-floor breakfast room, looking across historic Mechelen towards St Rumbold's Cathedral.
sisterHotelText: Discover our nearby four-star sister property, less than 200 metres from the heart of Mechelen.
